pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are irregularly polygonal with crenulated edges. The pixel-level geometry exhibits soft gradients rather than sharp boundaries due to significant motion blur across the entire frame. Patch density increases while spatial area decreases toward the posterior and lower limb regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network is comprised of light-colored pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are multi-directional. Pixel thickness of the pathways is inconsistent and diffused due to image blur, preventing precise measurement of pathway continuity.
